title: Travel-menu categories (e.g. 'toward the Meres', 'toward Pennywell') sometimes omit a landmark clearly stood on and central to the route - 'The Far Bank' (the literal Meres/Pennywell crossing tile) never appears under either region's travel list; you have to route via 'the Far Bank ferry' instead, a differently-named landmark filed under Pennywell.
where: Any 'travel to a known place' menu near the Meres/Pennywell border
